page.overview:
Who is Unnamed Council Member 2?

Unnamed Council Member 2 is a Coalition Council Member in Invincible, serving as a minor character from Season 2 and onwards.

He joined the Coalition and became an ambassador of the Coalition of planets.

He is a brown alien with an elongated face, two toed feet, some slim arms and a mammal-like nose. Category:Characters Category:A to Z Category:Aliens Category:Coalition of Planets
